line.name: El Baton
line.description: Not on the site. Originally created by founder Julius Caesar 'J.C.' Newman in 1914 as a nickel cigar hand-rolled in Cleveland, Ohio using Cuban tobacco; disappeared from the market in the 1920s as machine-made cigars took over. Revived in 2008 by 4th-generation Eric and Bobby Newman as the company's first all-Nicaraguan puro, then relaunched again in 2022/2024 with a bolder blend, higher-grade wrapper, and redesigned bands/boxes. Earned a 91 rating from Cigar Aficionado and was Cigar Journal's #2 Cigar of the Year (2023).
